test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following factors does NOT affect the climate of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Longitude**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Altitude**, **latitude**, and **winds** are significant factors affecting the climate of India.
 
• **Longitude** does not have a direct impact on the climate of India.
 
• **Altitude affects temperature and precipitation patterns**.
 
• **Latitude **influences the amount of solar energy received, affecting temperature and climate zones.
 
• Winds play a crucial role in the distribution of heat and moisture, affecting weather patterns and climate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's climate is influenced by multiple factors including geographic location, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
 
• The Indian subcontinent experiences diverse climatic conditions ranging from tropical in the south to temperate and alpine in the north.
 
• The Himalayas play a significant role in shaping the climate by **blocking cold winds from Central Asia**.
 
• The monsoon winds are a critical component of India's climate, bringing significant rainfall during the summer months.
